'''Patriot Hall''' was a large hallway at the entrance of [[Calimondretta]], the capital city of the [[Arkadianate]] which was situated on the icy planet of [[Syned]]. Its entrance was guarded by a large magnetic barrier which was administrated by [[Calimondretta Control]], which was responsible for controlling the entry and exit of vehicles into the city. During the [[Siege of Calimondretta]], much of the hall was damaged during an attack by [[Jarrow Rusher]]'s mercenary group [[Rusher's Brigade]] which infiltrated the city using a hijacked [[Icecrawler/Legends|icecrawler]] known as [[Crawler One]].
